ethics.notes: All participants were informed about the purpose of the study and their rights.

participants.instructions_given: Subjects instructed to handover the cup naturally, standing opposite the robot across the table.
participants.notes: Demographic fields are optional and should not include personally identifiable information.

environment.sensing_setup_description: Two RGB-D cameras were used to observe the handover area near the center of the table from the right-side and left-side views.
environment.calibration_notes: All cameras were calibrated and localized with respect to a 50cm square 5x5 ChArUco board before recording. The sensing setup was fixed during data collection. For camera-to-robot calibration, we used marker ID 49, as in the CORSMAL baseline source code.

software_and_models.notes: Geometry was estimated by fitting a canonical 3D category-level template to the merged dual-camera point cloud and measuring top width, bottom width, and height from the fitted shape. Fill level was estimated from the segmented RGB-D view by detecting the fill surface and container bottom, converting that distance to fill height, and computing filled versus total volume with a geometry-based volume model. Vision-based mass was then estimated from the filled volume using an assumed material density and a nominal empty-container mass. The weight of the container was not estimated, but instead provided as prior knowledge.

annotation_protocol.annotator_training: Timing annotations were performed by a team member following a fixed internal guideline for identifying handover start and end events
annotation_protocol.video_annotation_description: Execution timing was obtained from recorded videos at 30 fps using manual frame-level inspection.

configuration_file.subject_id_semantics: Subject IDs refer to the team's own volunteers performing the handovers.

learning_policy.note: We do not allow learning across configurations.
